get_auction.description: Get one auction house's fees, website and base currency. Use it to price up a sale at a particular house, or to turn a slug from any other step into a name and a link.
get_auction.name: get_auction

parameters.description: The auction house to report on. The list fills with every house Whisky Hunter tracks once the app is connected.
parameters.name: auction

base_currency.description: The currency the flat listing and reserve fees are charged in, e.g. 'GBP'. Empty when the house has no single base currency. Results are always reported in GBP regardless.

buyers_fee_percent.description: What the buyer pays on top of the hammer price, as a percentage

listing_fee_amount.description: The flat fee for listing one lot, in the house's base currency

name.description: The auction house's name, e.g. 'Whisky Auctioneer'

reserve_fee_amount.description: The flat fee for putting a reserve on one lot, in the house's base currency

sellers_fee_percent.description: What is deducted from the seller's proceeds, as a percentage

slug.description: The auction house's identifier, e.g. 'whiskyauctioneer'. Every action here that takes an auction house takes this.

total_commission_percent.description: The buyer's and seller's fees added together: the round-trip commission on a hammer price at this house

description: Track the secondary whisky market with Whisky Hunter. Compare what the online auction houses charge to buy and to sell, follow any distillery's prices month by month (the cheapest, mean and dearest bottle, the money its bottles fetched and how many sold), put distilleries or auction houses side by side over any period, and read the whole market's monthly volume back to 2005. No account or API key is required.
